title: internal/policy resolvers: WorkflowConfig leaks mutable slices and double-assigns, two resolvers accept negative overrides, BaseCLI is duplicated, and ADR-0076 is two ADRs
summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 3 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) WorkflowConfig (workflow.go) assigns RemediationRounds, RemediablePhases and BuildFloorEnforced twice; the second block is a duplicate. (2) WorkflowConfig passes RemediablePhases and PhaseEnables through by reference while copying UniversalFallbackExclude and InteractivePolicies, so a caller that mutates the result alters the resolved policy (an immutability breach). (3) go/internal/setup/setup.go:44 keeps its own baseCLI, duplicating policy.BaseCLI, which was meant to be the only copy. (4) ChronicleConfig and FailureDispositionConfig override on != 0, so negative values pass; the other resolvers require > 0. (5) docs/architecture/adr has two ADR-0076 files (convergence-architecture and failure-disposition-boundary-escalation), so a `See ADR-0076.` pointer is ambiguous. (6) Several file names no longer match their contents (merge_catalog.go, fleet.go, routing_gates.go); the split that caused this also orphaned eight godocs, which batch 3 re-attached.
fix: Remove the duplicate block. Return copies of every slice and map from WorkflowConfig, with a test that mutates the result and re-resolves. Delete setup's baseCLI and call policy.BaseCLI. Require > 0 in the two resolvers, with a negative-value test for each. Renumber one ADR-0076 and fix its inbound links. Regroup policy files by the type they resolve, as a separate refactor commit.
acceptance: Mutating any slice or map returned by WorkflowConfig leaves a second WorkflowConfig() call unchanged (test)
A negative chronicle or failure-disposition override resolves to the default (tests)
docs/architecture/adr has one file per ADR number
